name: VoxelGrid
definition: A 3D voxel grid that defines a parameterized function in 3D space, storing learnable values at the middle of voxels but effectively storing corner values for interpolation.
summary: VoxelGrid is a dense, fixed-resolution 3D data structure that stores scene properties at grid vertices for efficient trilinear interpolation, serving as a differentiable, learnable replacement for implicit neural networks in neural rendering.
